description: This file defines the BeanListRequest class, which encapsulates parameters for requesting a list of beans, including filtering, ordering, pagination, and selection options, and provides a fetch method to retrieve the list response.

classes.name: BeanListRequest
classes.description: A class representing a request to retrieve a list of beans, supporting various filtering and pagination options, and responsible for executing the request to fetch the results.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the request with a specific SugarBean instance.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Sets the order by clause for the list request.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Sets the where/filter clause for the list request.

methods.name: limit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the number of records to retrieve.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of records to fetch.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Specifies whether to include deleted records.

methods.name: singleSelect
methods.description: Indicates whether the request is for a single selection.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Specifies which fields to include in the response.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Executes the list request and returns a BeanListResponse object containing the results.
